directive.quote: Implement a bounded generic CLI HTTP429 Retry-After/deadline fix.

sources.note: PACKAGE-SET-IDENTITY-EXEMPT: exact source path for this contract's source slice.

targets.note: PACKAGE-SET-IDENTITY-EXEMPT: exact helper path this contract owns.

preserve: Allowed retries reuse one serialized request body and request key.
A non-idempotent operation with an unknown outcome retains the request key for explicit exact replay.
Transcript-based record recovery retains batch keys, resumes written batches, and reads records back.
allowed_deltas: HTTP 429 Retry-After accepts delta-seconds and HTTP dates; invalid values use existing backoff and past dates use zero delay.
A per-request deadline bounds attempts and retry waits.
Transport loss, HTTP 5xx, structured sign_in_too_many_calls, and unknown outcomes do not automatically resend non-idempotent operations.
banned_substitutions: Do not change the serialized body or request key between an allowed retry and an explicit replay.
Do not add session initialization to operation calls.
Do not test by probing a live account limiter or making account writes.

baseline.note: The new helper starts as the exact selected request-sender block from the committed source. Adaptation follows in a later commit.
